verdict.rationale: System-wide built-in dictation is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents voice typing or AI dictation in Windows. Live Captions transcribes audio playback rather than dictating text input, and the Copilot and local-AI mentions say nothing about dictation, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate text anywhere in the system using built-in AI dictation
